Widths 2,4,3 are matched at 1..2, 5..8, and 11..13 in the output, with gaps 3..4 and 9..10 precisely mirroring their input counterparts. So, gaps between objects are preserved.


**Confirming Slot Spacing**

I've got it! The gaps between the slots are also being preserved. The start position of the first object is as in the original layout. I've double-checked with Example 3, and this rule is holding up perfectly. I need to make the rule explicit: identify connected components, determine axis of separation, calculate and sort object areas, and place them along the axis in sorted order. First object starts at the original minimum coordinate and the gaps between are preserved.

The goal is to fully define all objects to later compute their areas and other metrics of interest. I will continue to process the input based on these parameters.
